agentGuide: Projects first: GET /account/v3/projects (id, name); most calls take a zone or region in the path (fr-par-1, nl-ams-1; regions fr-par, nl-ams, pl-waw). Instances: GET /instance/v1/zones/fr-par-1/servers?project=<id> (id, name, state, public_ip, commercial_type); one: GET .../servers/<id>; action: POST .../servers/<id>/action {"action": "poweron"} (poweroff, reboot, stop_in_place); create: POST .../servers {...} then POST .../action poweron — it costs money. Object storage buckets: GET /object/v1/regions/fr-par/buckets?project_id=<id>... (S3 itself needs its own keys). Serverless: GET /functions/v1beta1/regions/fr-par/functions?project_id=<id>, containers: /containers/v1beta1/.... Managed databases: GET /rdb/v1/regions/fr-par/instances. Billing: GET /billing/v2beta1/consumptions?organization_id=<id>. IAM: GET /iam/v1alpha1/api-keys?organization_id=<id>. The key is set by Allkin.
